title: Xross Local View Contract v1
$comment: Portable DTO schema. A host validator must enforce the complete x-xross-* vocabulary in addition to standard JSON Schema keywords. Reject any unpaired UTF-16 surrogate in any parsed string before schema acceptance or byte accounting, including escaped lone surrogates; UTF-8 encoders must not replace them. x-xross-maxUtf8Bytes is a UTF-8 byte bound; x-xross-maxEncodedBytes is the RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 byte length of the complete instance at that schema node, checked after standard schema and non-size Xross constraints. This is a portable DTO-value bound, not a transport limit. The transport annotation's adapter application-byte scopes are exact: local WebView counts the complete UTF-8 serialized kkrpc message at the native/WebView adapter seam (including the kkrpc envelope); hosted fetch request/response count exact HTTP entity-body bytes (zero-argument no-body requests count zero); hosted NDJSON streamEventBytes counts each record's raw UTF-8 bytes including its LF or CRLF delimiter when present, and counts an unterminated final record without a delimiter. Enforce raw message/body byte ceilings before JSON parsing; HTTP headers and lower-layer TLS/OS IPC framing are excluded. u64 wire values use canonical decimal text because WebView JSON cannot preserve arbitrary JavaScript integer precision. The catalog's request schema describes one DTO argument, not a kkrpc frame: the native host must enforce exactly argumentCount entries in the incoming args array, then validate the single request object. Optional object fields are absent, never null or undefined. Stream event payloads require per-yield validation because kkrpc's output hook sees the AsyncIterable object, not each yielded event.

byteScopes.localWebView: Complete UTF-8 serialized kkrpc message at the native/WebView adapter seam, including kkrpc envelope metadata.
byteScopes.hostedFetchRequest: Exact RequestInit.body bytes exposed to Fetch; zero-argument methods with no body count zero bytes.
byteScopes.hostedFetchResponse: Exact Response.body bytes exposed by Fetch for unary success/error responses, including typed error bodies.
byteScopes.hostedFetchStreamEvent: Exact raw UTF-8 bytes of one NDJSON record, including its LF or CRLF delimiter when present; an unterminated final record has no delimiter byte.

x-xross-call-encoding: kkrpc-call-args-array; exact arity from argumentCount; request schema validates args[0] only; zero-argument methods require [] and have request:null

DeviceIdV1.description: Canonical Display spelling of the authenticated nonzero 128-bit Xross DeviceId.

ServiceInstanceIdV1.description: Pinned Refyard service-process identity; changes across restarts.

WorkspaceRootIdV1.description: Target-minted Refyard workspace root id; not a filesystem path or authority by possession.

PathIdV1.description: Target-minted opaque selector; display paths are never accepted in its place.

RefyardSnapshotIdV1.description: Domain-tagged encoding of Plan 0082's RefyardSnapshotId; the target privately maps it to Refyard's source snap_ id.

PathPreviewTokenV1.description: Pinned Refyard path preview precondition token; never a mutation preview handle.

MutationPreviewIdV1.description: Native-owned single-use mutation approval ledger handle; distinct from Refyard source op_ and pt_ identifiers.

RefyardJobIdV1.description: Domain-tagged encoding of Plan 0082's distinct 128-bit RefyardJobId.

MutationRecoveryIdV1.description: Native-owned durable recovery-row identity; distinct from job, preview and source operation ids.

MutationRecoverySnapshotIdV1.description: Native-owned recovery page snapshot identity; distinct from recovery-row and Refyard source snapshot ids.

packDigest.description: SHA-256 bytes encoded as lowercase hexadecimal.

ObjectIdV1.description: Git object id; the selected repository object format determines the accepted width.

DisplayPathV1.description: Target-authored root/worktree-relative display data only; never request authority.

GitRefNameV1.description: Source-authored Git branch or tag display name; preserves code points exactly.

RemoteUrlInputV1.description: HTTPS or SSH remote syntax only; reject local/file paths and inline credentials, query secrets and fragments.

DestinationV1.description: Forward-slash-separated relative destination; no dot segments, .git component, drive prefix, absolute root, or backslash.
